production_domain.encoded_video: sRGB OETF pixels, BT.709 primaries/matrix, limited range
production_domain.scope: Behavioural baseline and quality reference only. Do not use as a numeric oracle for the Adobe DNG Converter / DNG SDK / ACEScg chain: the two chains do not promise pixel equality.

nan_policy: JSON null represents a non-finite float (NaN or +-Inf). The legacy reporting layer uses the same convention. Tile validity is carried explicitly by the 'valid' mask; pixel-sample binary files contain raw IEEE-754 values, including NaN padding.
